interpretation: No demonstrated exact-yield benefit on this pre-MS07 cohort: 0 verified exact hits in 256 grid trials (up to two samples each), the two native kinds included. This is not a finding that S1 must be dropped and it implies no S9 (bank) routing decision.

Three distinct problems are kept apart (the "Separate problems" table) and are not merged into one verdict: (a) empty frontiers: samples that finished phase A with no frontier entry because every refused group proved ambiguous; (b) shallow, above-band or below-band candidates among those that did reach the canonical rating; (c) searches cut by the count budget.
The native samples also had zero hits: 0 exact of 128 native samples (89 of them shallow, in band without needing the tier); the frontier variants had 0 verified hits.

These two-sample grid trials exclude whole-request recovery (up to 8, 4 or 2 attempts by board size, up to 12 samples per grid) and the local-search continuation (IG-S-Q05 records that the one historical mega16 hit came from local search): a zero here is not a request-level yield and says nothing about the frozen catalogue.
104 of the 104 paired intervals are degenerate (every resample identical, the all-zero [0, 0] ones): they are not evidence of equivalence or non-inferiority.
Two-grid budget fits are experimental limits, not tail guarantees; the screen is rerun on the frozen catalogue before any decision.

interpretationNotes: the intervals come from eight whole grid clusters per cell and are descriptive provisional ones with poor small-sample coverage, not lower-confidence guarantees
a per-sample rate is not extrapolated to an unqualified 90% request claim; two-grid budget fits are experimental limits, not tail guarantees
the zero-baseline feasibility threshold (the lower-bound rate projecting to half of the requests inside the budget at width 4) is projection-awaits-author-review, never evaluated here
F0/F1 is the isolated S2 comparison, FC/FM/F1 the floor choices, FU/F1 the uniqueness filter, FS/F1 the reference-parent choice; the gains are correlated and are not multiplied
the final phase A parent classification is a post-timing diagnostic: it never steers generation and never enters a hit count
unreached keys are unstarted/inconclusive: they are not zero-cost trials and not censored observations

acceptance.evidence: rates.json and paired-intervals.json: verified hits per ready CPU and wall second of every mode, the two native kinds included, with the paired difference of each frontier variant against each

zero-hit rates are shown with their trial counts, the budget-ended share and the unstarted keys; a hit counts once per grid trial; censored and budget-ended trials stay in the denominators (256 of 256 keys started)

selection.json (r1, unchanged, hash recomputed equal) is a labelled diagnostic written before the held-out cohort: F1 as an explicitly non-winning default in every cell; the pack author reviewed the raw paired coverage and passed it (closure of 2026-11-15)
every started trial lists the state of ordinals 1 and 2 (returned, sample-budget, skipped-first-exact, censored, not-reached); unstarted keys are listed as unstarted (0)
one grid per mode built afresh; the grid hashes of the modes of a cluster are equal (0 clusters differ); the forks are model, grid#1, dig#1.1, dig#1.2
the frozen IG-S04 budget vector of each cell is used by every frontier arm of that cell (hash classic9 equal, mega12 equal, mega16 equal, samurai equal)
whole grid clusters are resampled together (2,000 draws, seed 20261114); zero hits give a zero lower bound; no pseudo-count
0 false exact flags, 0 error records; every numerator is a claimed AND independently verified exact return; the denominator is all engine-ready-to-cleanup CPU/wall of the started trials
